title: Meadow Market
description: Plant four crops, harvest into your basket, sell at the stall and grow a tiny farm into a 5,000-coin business in three minutes.
controls: Tap a crop, then an empty plot to plant. Tap ripe crops to harvest, tap the market to sell, tap upgrades to buy plots, fertilizer, a helper and a delivery truck.

zh-CN.title: 草地集市
zh-CN.description: 种下四种作物，收进篮子再到集市卖掉，扩地、施肥、雇帮手和货车，3 分钟内把小农场做到累计 5,000 金币。
zh-CN.controls: 先选作物再点空地种下；成熟后点击收获，点集市卖出；点下方升级购买地块、肥料、小帮手和货车。
